_doc: Copy to ~/.claude/guardrails/scheduled-jobs.json. Each key is the value of CLAUDE_GUARD_SCHEDULED_JOB set by the launchd plist or cron line of a headless job. A job gets the tier-3 scopes listed here and nothing else. A missing key or scope is a deny. The variable is honoured only for a claude with no terminal and no claude ancestor, and the locked scopes guard-config and guard-misconfigured are never granted to a job.
